content.text: About Description Husband to Kate, Dad to Leo & Charlotte European & PGA TOUR golfer 2013 US Open Champion Rio 2016 Olympic GOLD Medalist 2018 FedEx Cup Champion #TeamRose Your dream fourball? If I could turn back the years, I would have liked to play more golf with my dad. It would also be an honour to play with President Nelson Mandela and Roger Federer. Swing thought when hitting long irons? Making sure that I have the ball position far enough forward in my stance.
